screens.title: Town HUD
screens.description: Click a belt slot or press 1-6. Hover the belt for item details.

screens.title: Dialogue
screens.description: Click to finish the line, then pick an answer.

screens.title: Inventory & equipment
screens.description: Scroll the bag; hover the weapon slot.

screens.title: Battle
screens.description: Pick a command or a party member; Attack shows the damage.

screens.title: Shop
screens.description: Pick an item; Buy shows the cost, Leave asks to confirm.

screens.title: Character select
screens.description: Browse the cast with the arrows; faces stay minimal and emotes carry the mood.

hud.title: 小镇 HUD
hud.description: 点击腰带格子或按 1-6 切换；悬停查看物品说明。

dialogue.title: 对话
dialogue.description: 点击显示完整台词，再选择回答。

inventory.title: 背包与装备
inventory.description: 滚动背包，悬停武器栏查看说明。

battle.title: 战斗
battle.description: 选择指令或队员；选“攻击”会显示伤害数字。

shop.title: 商店
shop.description: 选择商品；购买会显示花费，离开会弹出确认。

select.title: 角色选择
select.description: 用箭头浏览角色；五官保持极简，用表情气泡表达情绪。
